name: todo
description: Durable repository and external-workflow routing through mode-independent ToDo tasks.

interface.longDescription: Routes repository mutations through monotonically numbered local .todo tasks even without an explicit ToDo mention, hot-reloads worker/profile configuration without interrupting active tasks, runs work in background Codex workers by default, exposes live execution prompts, transcripts, raw logs, results, and usage in the local dashboard, and keeps external Jira/Asana-style work items synchronized with AI-attributed audit comments independently of background or interactive execution.
defaultPrompt: Use $todo:route to route this repository change through ToDo.
Use $todo:run with a referenced task file to execute it in this thread.
Use $todo:status to show tasks and workers.
